item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 13/Jan/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A maritime airstream will bring warm and foggy weather to the coast of Guangdong today and tomorrow. A cold front is expected to move across the coast of southern China during the day on Sunday. Under the influence of the associated intense northeast monsoon, the weather over the region will be cold and improve early to midweek next week.

Date/Month: 13/01 (Friday)
Wind: Southeast force 2 to 3.
Weather: Mainly cloudy and foggy. One or two rain patches at first.
Temp range: 19 - 23 C
R.H. range: 85 - 100 per Cent
PSR: Low
